description:
## Goal

Make backend executable and callable-construction references independent of root enumeration, so adding or removing an unrelated reachable member cannot change an existing member's identity or force a body copy. Migrate every backend consumer atomically and share immutable member payloads.

## Current evidence at 167faceaa

BackendProgram in src/compiler2/artifact.rs owns entry: usize, Vec<BackendExecutable> and Vec<BackendConstructionWrapper>. Backend bodies embed root-assigned executable usize targets and u32 construction identities. jobs/backend.rs produce_root_backend_product creates a semantic-sorted executable_index and construction enumeration; package_symbolic_backend_executable then clones metadata and traverses SymbolicBackendBody into BackendBody because these references depend on root membership. NativeLowerer and ir_interp/backend.rs consume these dense positions.

Thus an earlier-sorted reachable insertion can rewrite references in an otherwise unchanged body. Rc symbolic inputs do not avoid the second packaging traversal or final payload copies. A keyed contribution optimization cannot preserve immutable member identity on top of that model.

Struct membership is already derived from reached backends with exact StructDefined reads; do not recreate a whole-World schema bug or broaden this ticket into source ownership.

## Strategy

1. Reuse existing typed semantic executable and construction ownership identities wherever possible; introduce no rendered/canonical type authority, raw-mint ordering, duplicate identity registry, or root-relative index as semantic authority.
2. Make BackendExecutable(E) the complete immutable consumer-ready local artifact, with exact ABI/layout/return/construction dependencies. Collapse SymbolicBackend and Backend duplicate body forms/traversal at the cutover, not through a compatibility layer.
3. Make BackendProgram hold immutable shared keyed member payloads and typed entry/reference identities. Migrate interpreter, native lowering, dumps, canonical rendering, macro roots, and tests together.
4. Keep any required dense ordinals at actual native link/runtime representation or canonical display boundaries. Do not recover old root remapping through a second cache, adapter, fallback scanner, or parallel authority.
5. Preserve efficient interpreter/native calls. Investigate representation cost explicitly rather than replacing direct calls with unmeasured expensive lookup or copying.
6. Leave exact delta root membership/contribution reconciliation to fz-tfn.18, which remains blocked on this ticket. Do not claim the remaining whole-root inventory rebuild is incremental. Immutable membership collection updates must eventually use structural sharing, not Rc<HashMap>::make_mut copying retained snapshots; fz-tfn.18 owns that remaining proof.

## TDD signal and acceptance

- Minimal retained main -> left/right, right -> zleaf program: retain right's executable allocation and typed target; edit left to reach an earlier-sorted aleaf. Right keeps its exact allocation, generation where applicable, and target identity. Reverse the edit and withdraw aleaf without rewriting right.
- A relevant right/zleaf edit changes exactly the appropriate artifact/dependency, not a stale reused body.
- Callable construction references remain exact across insertion/removal and preserve direct-only, boxed, captured, zero-lane, recursive and polymorphic obligations.
- Backend member payloads share existing immutable allocations; no second body conversion or root-relative executable/construction remap survives.
- Preserve runtime output, diagnostics, ABI/calling contracts, effects, source metadata, and canonical artifact fidelity. Proven-unused removal is permitted with explicit causal proof under the epic's approved acceptance; same-version determinism/reuse remain mandatory.
- No new compiler cache/store beside World facts and retained ProductMemo. Necessary local ordinal projections are consumers, not alternate semantic authorities.
- Full library, serial fixture matrix, interp/run/build and native/macro tests, cross-process canonical/causal checks, formatting/check/strict clippy and relevant documentation pass.
- Fresh ticket-scoped cold review; one commit and close. Any newly discovered prerequisite must be evidenced and ticketed before work; no silent scope reduction.

## Concordance and remaining work

fz-tfn.18 owns exact executable/wrapper/atom/schema contribution updates, rooted recursive-cycle withdrawal and deletion of root inventory scans, union_boxed aggregation, repeated atom walks and schema copies. Its scope is unchanged.

fz-tfn.13 consumes these stable backend references when defining native-body/link identities; it still owns native per-body lowering/codegen products and deletion of the post-lowering sharing pass. This ticket does not implement a parallel native identity model or claim body-incremental codegen complete.
title: Make backend members immutable and references independent of root enumeration
